summary.text: Romaine Quinn is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Senate who represents District 25 and is the Republican candidate for Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026, general election.
He previously served in the State Assembly from 2015 to 2021 and as mayor of Rice Lake.

paragraphs.text: Romaine Quinn was born in Wisconsin and lives in Cameron.
He graduated from Rice Lake High School and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and public leadership from the University of Wisconsin-Green Bay.
Quinn was elected to the Rice Lake City Council during his last year of high school and was later elected mayor of Rice Lake.
He represented Assembly District 75 from 2015 to 2021 and assumed office in the Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Democrat Janet Bewley.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Joint Finance, Information Policy and Technology, Joint Legislative Council, and Senate Education, where he is vice-chair.
